items.title: Annual report period and September 1 due date
items.body: July 1–June 30; verify applicability including active WDID duration.

items.title: COI when information changes
items.body: Verify site/organization, scope, schedule, acreage and risk changes.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: Final stabilization
items.body: Verify evidence and conditions with the Regional Water Board.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: Notice of Termination
items.body: Verify termination grounds and documentation; NOT is not CEQA Notice of Determination.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: Manual EPA values over annual periods
items.body: EPA runs are manual, at most one year per period; sum values for the overall R entered in NOI/COI.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: Construction dates
items.body: Initial earth disturbance, including vertical build, through final stabilization; verify the site schedule.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: Leap-year ambiguity
items.body: Guide warns Dec 31 in leap years may fail and suggests Dec 30. Never change dates silently; Feb 29 / >365-day windows require manual verification.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: COI information changes
items.body: Verify site information, risk, inactivity/reactivation and other changed fields.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: COI certifier policy
items.body: Ready/Submitted requires reason plus assigned LRP/DAR and eAuthorization Yes. DEP may prepare. This is a local blocker, not agency submission.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: COI reason for change
items.body: Record a meaningful reason and the revised fields.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: COI attachment warnings
items.body: Guide states 100 MB and 30-character file-name limit with no special characters. Required attachments depend on changed fields; verify.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: Acreage increase fee
items.body: A disturbed-acreage increase may require a COI fee; enter the verified amount manually.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: COI decisions / remand
items.body: Track Approved, Returned, Denied or Remanded manually; verify actual agency action.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: Site vs organization COI
items.body: Keep Site and Organization COI records separate; verify the correct action.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: Annual report calendar
items.body: July 1–June 30 period; September 1 due date. Verify annual applicability.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: Weekly and storm-event inspections
items.body: Use existing inspections and corrections; verify frequency/qualifying-event conditions in the permit.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.title: REAP replaced in 2022 CGP
items.body: Permit fact sheet describes replacement of REAP. Do not add a REAP checklist requirement; verify current conditions.
items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board

items.verify_label: Verify with current permit / Regional Water Board
